image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage black typewriter. The focus is on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the long, rectangular space bar at the bottom center. The keys are circular with red and white lettering/accents. The body of the typewriter has a textured, possibly leather or cracked paint finish. In the background, the carriage and platen are visible but slightly out of focus.
